sourceRecords.title: French Floating Offshore Wind Farm Starts Delivering Electricity
sourceRecords.sourceText: OffshoreWIND.biz reported that Ocean Winds started electricity production at the 30 MW EFGL floating offshore wind farm in southern France. The source states the pilot has three 10 MW turbines on floating foundations located 16 kilometres offshore.
sourceRecords.licenseNote: Public webpage; source text stored as concise factual evidence for manual archive prototype review.

sourceRecords.title: Wison New Energies Showcases Floating Wind Platform Design with Four-Column Semi-Submersible Concept for 16 MW Turbines at OTC 2026
sourceRecords.sourceText: Wison New Energies reported that it presented a four-column semi-submersible floating wind platform concept for 16 MW turbines at OTC 2026, comparing it with a three-column design under North Atlantic metocean conditions.
sourceRecords.licenseNote: Public webpage; source text stored as concise factual evidence for manual archive prototype review.

sourceRecords.title: Qair Browsing Scottish Ports for 1 GW Floating Wind Farm's O&M Base
sourceRecords.sourceText: offshoreWIND.biz reported that Qair began assessing Orkney and Caithness ports for a long-term O&M base for the 1 GW Ayre floating offshore wind farm.
sourceRecords.licenseNote: Public webpage; source text stored as concise factual evidence for manual archive prototype review.

sourceRecords.title: China Three Gorges installs 16-MW floating wind turbine
sourceRecords.sourceText: Renewables Now reported that China Three Gorges installed a 16 MW floating wind turbine in China, identifying the item as offshore wind technology news.

sourceRecords.sourceText: Green Volt reported that ecological survey work had started along the onshore cable route for the floating offshore wind project.

briefingItems.title: EFGL starts delivering electricity
briefingItems.oneLineSummary: Ocean Winds started electricity production at the 30 MW EFGL floating offshore wind farm.
briefingItems.explanation: The source records first power from a Mediterranean floating wind pilot project.

briefingItems.title: Wison presents 16 MW semi-submersible platform concept
briefingItems.oneLineSummary: Wison presented a four-column semi-submersible floating wind platform concept for 16 MW turbines at OTC 2026.
briefingItems.explanation: The source describes platform concept selection, hydrodynamic comparison, stability, structural dynamics, and coupled-response evaluation for large-capacity floating wind.

briefingItems.title: Qair assesses ports for Ayre floating wind O&M base
briefingItems.oneLineSummary: Qair started assessing northern Scotland ports for the long-term O&M base for the 1 GW Ayre floating offshore wind farm.
briefingItems.explanation: The source identifies the project capacity, candidate port areas, logistics review, and supply-chain planning around floating wind operations.

briefingItems.title: China Three Gorges installs 16 MW floating turbine
briefingItems.oneLineSummary: China Three Gorges installed a 16 MW floating offshore wind turbine in China.
briefingItems.explanation: The source identifies a large-capacity floating wind turbine installation milestone in the Asia-Pacific market.

briefingItems.title: Green Volt begins ecological cable-route surveys
briefingItems.oneLineSummary: Green Volt started ecological survey work on its onshore cable route for the floating offshore wind project.
briefingItems.explanation: The source connects the floating wind project to environmental survey work needed for cable-route and consenting development.
